# IsoCad — WebGL2 CAD & Industrial Piping Isometric PDF Platform

> IsoCad is a browser-native 60 FPS WebGL2 CAD drafting and industrial Piping PDF intelligence editor developed with React 19, TypeScript, and SOLID architecture.

## Core Capabilities
- **WebGL2 Vector CAD Engine**: GPU-instanced line/polyline rendering, R-Tree (`rbush`) OSNAP snapping directly on PDF vector paths, `F5` Isoplane (30°/90°/150°), `F8` Ortho, AutoCAD CLI (`L`, `PL`, `C`, `REC`, `DIM`, `CLOUD`, `@150<30`), and blue/green window selection.
- **Automated Piping PDF Extraction**: Parses Danieli (English & Russian Cyrillic), Linde/Energiron, and stamped As-Built isometric PDFs in-browser to generate `MTO`, `Weld_Log`, `Cut_List`, and `Support_List`.
- **As-Built Weldmap Stamping**: Edge-snapping leader lines (`atan2` / slab-ray / triangle edge projection) with dual-compartment Field (`F` Triangle) and Shop (`S` Circle) weld/welder stamps.
- **Lossless Exporters**: Vector PDF (`pdf-lib` with embedded `isocad-weldmap.json`), 5-sheet formatted Excel (`exceljs`), and layered AutoCAD `.dxf`.
- **External Endpoint Integration**: Bidirectional sync via `RestWebhookAdapter`, `LaravelApiAdapter`, and `PostMessageBridge` (`ISOCAD_DOCUMENT_SAVED`).

## Routes
- `/` — Product overview, interactive WebGL2 isometric preview, architecture & FAQ (TR / EN / RU)
- `/demo` — Live Sandbox Demo with real Danieli & Russian isometric PDFs
- `/editor` — Full industrial workspace with localStorage + IndexedDB persistence
- `/docs` — Developer documentation & API integration specifications
